name: Chika Chosokabe
source: Fashionable and popular, but not in the least stuck-up, Chika is well-liked by her classmates. She's a big fan of idols, often following news about them on her phone instead of paying attention in class. She can be found working at the mall on weekend afternoons.
translation: Fashionable and popular, but not in the least stuck-up, Chika is well-liked by her classmates. She's a big fan of idols, often following news about them on her phone instead of paying attention in class. She can be found working at the mall on weekend afternoons.
